I built the history log for TASK-0048 and committed it on `reqforge/TASK-0048` as `c1f9293`. Eval E1 passes (all 6 tests). E2, the browser test of the gap prompt, was not run: that suite doesn't exist yet and belongs to TASK-0049.

**What changed**
- **History file**: `server/src/history.rs` writes `history/sessions.jsonl` in the requirements repo, one line at a time.
  - Each entry has kind, id, project, user, start, end, outcome, changesets proposed and applied, and records touched.
  - Entries are built from a fixed set of fields, so no prompt, message or tool output can be stored.
- **Pause and gaps**: users can pause the project with a reason. A gap of 14 days or more is recorded as deliberate if there was a pause with a reason, and as unexplained otherwise. If the user doesn't record the gap at the start of the next session, it is recorded automatically when that session is logged.
- **Compaction**: entries older than 365 days are replaced by one summary per month, with session count, total duration and outcome counts. Newer entries are untouched. It runs at most once a day and makes one commit; with nothing to compact it writes nothing.
- **Agent runs** add their entry in the same commit as the existing run log. Outcome is success, failed, cancelled, timeout or violation.
- **Chat sessions** are tracked in server memory, one per Claude session, and written to the history in two cases:
  - the UI calls `POST /api/chat/end {session_id}`;
  - the session has been idle for 30 minutes (`REQFORGE_CHAT_IDLE_MIN`).
- **API**:
  - `GET /api/history`;
  - `GET` / `POST /api/history/gap {reason}`;
  - `POST /api/history/pause {reason}`;
  - `POST /api/history/compact`.
  - A new chat session now starts with a `gap` event when a gap is pending.
- **Background job**: the existing scheduler tick also writes out idle chat sessions and runs compaction once a day.
- **Also**: a `changes::touched_ids` helper, and a short paragraph in `docs/agent-runs.md`.

**Tests**
- `cargo test --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --test history`: 6 passed, covering REQ-0062#AC1 to #AC4. The tests check that no secret prompt, reply or tool text reaches the file, that the file is only ever appended to, that compaction makes one commit per day, and how gaps are typed.
- Full `cargo test`: every suite passes. Clippy reports nothing in the new code.

**Open points for review**
- **Ending chat sessions**: nothing in the UI calls `/api/chat/end` yet. Until TASK-0049 wires it to "new chat" or panel close, chat sessions are only logged after 30 idle minutes. Sessions still open when the server restarts are lost.
- **Gap typing vs. reason**: a reason given at the next session start is stored on the gap record, but an unexplained gap stays unexplained. The type only reflects whether the project was paused. Please confirm that's the intended reading of AC4.
- **Records touched**:
  - for an agent run it is just the task;
  - for a chat changeset that creates a record without a reference, the new id is left out.
- **Commits**: each logged chat session makes its own commit in the requirements repo. The history is only as private as that repo.
- **Test fake**: the integration test's fake `claude` switches between chat and agent mode on the `--permission-mode` argument. I first used `REQFORGE_TASK`, but the shell running these tests inherits it from this agent run.
